name: io.github.bundleglobal/bundlesocial-mcp
description: Post, schedule, comment on and analyze content across 14+ social platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack, Google Business Profile) via the bundle.social API — plus team & integration management, media uploads, and post-history/comment/CSV imports.

environmentVariables.name: BUNDLESOCIAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: bundle.social API key. Create one at https://bundle.social/dashboard/organization/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: BUNDLESOCIAL_TEAM_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default team id. Optional — needed only if your organization has more than one team.

environmentVariables.name: BUNDLESOCIAL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL (default https://api.bundle.social). For self-hosted/staging targets.
